settings.show_progress.label: Show progress bar
settings.show_progress.description: Display the current playback position below the artist or channel.
settings.font_family.label: Text font family
settings.font_family.description: A system font family for the title and artist. Leave blank to use Noctalia's default font.
settings.show_background.label: Show background
settings.show_background.description: Show the translucent card background behind the media controls.
settings.show_shadow.label: Show shadow edge
settings.show_shadow.description: Show the subtle elevated card edge. Native drop shadows are not currently exposed to declarative plugin widgets.
settings.hide_when_idle.label: Hide when idle
settings.hide_when_idle.description: Hide the widget when no active MPRIS player is available.
